column3: Evidence for treating equal fingerprints as regional counterparts
Timer increment at +0x100 is 8 on PAL and 10 on NTSC-U
Timeout at +0x78 is 150 on PAL and 180 on NTSC-U
Timeout at +0x90 is 300 on PAL and 360 on NTSC-U
Timeout at +0x80 is 100 on PAL and 120 on NTSC-U in both placements
Seven label addresses use offsets 0x261 through 0x341 on PAL and 0x260 through 0x340 on NTSC-U (32-byte entries).
Eight byte loads read offsets 0x6AC through 0x6B3 on PAL and 0x6A8 through 0x6AF on NTSC-U.
The relocated direct call selects func_L01_0041BE20 on PAL and func_L01_00421DD0 on NTSC-U.
Relocated symbols differ: func_00382468 on PAL and func_0037E1D8 on NTSC-U, func_003A2B68 on PAL and func_0039DAE0 on NTSC-U, D_L19_001DED24 on PAL and D_L19_001DED64 on NTSC-U.
